d.t: A Korean stew, typically made with meat, seafood or vegetables in a seasoned broth and served boiling hot.
d.e: This was where my obsession with jjigae began. I set out to learn how to make not only this gateway jjigae, but all of the most popular jjigae of Korean cuisine: sundubu jjigae, kimchi jiigae^([sic]), gochujang jjigae and doenjang jjigae. Chicken soup may be for the soul, but…
